Container.Name: CineDock
Container.Overview: Your media server. A completely new way to enjoy it. Breathe new life into Plex, Emby or Jellyfin with a cinematic experience for televisions, phones and browsers.
Container.Description: CineDock gives an existing Emby, Jellyfin or Plex server a polished interface for televisions, phones and browsers. It does not scan, copy or change media files. Install the container, open its web page and connect your media server.
Container.DonateText: Enjoying CineDock? Support its continued development.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port you open in your browser to use CineDock.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Where CineDock stores its server connection and small caches.

Config.Name: TMDB API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. A free TMDB key adds actor biographies, filmographies and trailer fallback. CineDock works without it, and it can also be added later in Settings.
